Understanding the conflicting reports about where DOJ is investigating E. Jean Carroll on criminal charges: joycevance.substack.com/p/e-…

Is DOJ investigating E. Jean Carroll? Conflicting reports say yes—and no.

But the more important question may be whether DOJ can afford to. The allegations appear remarkably weak, raising serious questions about whether any prosecution would survive claims of vindictive or selective prosecution. And at a moment when courts are already scrutinizing DOJ's independence, pursuing a case that looks political could come with significant consequences.
